description: Everything lib/desktop.ts needs: window controls for the custom header, drag regions, resize events, platform detection, the native folder chooser behind the working-folder picker, the update check / install / relaunch flow, OS notifications, and the dock badge / attention request for turns that finish while the window is in the background. `remote.urls` names the dev server alone: the production port is only known at launch, and a loopback wildcard would offer all of this to whatever else is listening, so `grant_remote_origin` (src/lib.rs) re-reads this file and grants it to the one resolved origin instead.
